# Distance

Measures distance from each element to a point, line or plane.

`lfs.distance` · Utilities

## How to use

Connect Position to Vector.\
Plane mode returns a signed distance; Point and Line return non-negative distances.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Vector | `Vector` | lfs.vector | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Positions to measure. |
| Point | `Point` | lfs.vector | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Point on the target point, line or plane. |
| Direction | `Direction` | lfs.vector | [1.0, 0.0, 0.0] | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Direction of the target line. |
| Normal | `Normal` | lfs.vector | [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Normal of the target plane. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Distance | `Distance` | lfs.float | — | — | Distance in scene units. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mode | `mode` | enum | point | point; line; plane | Measure to a point, line or plane. |
